description: Source code for the MS5607 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing sensor initialization, measurement, compensation, and configuration functions.

methods.name: ms5607_compensate
methods.description: Performs temperature and pressure compensation calculations based on ADC readings.

methods.name: ms5607_read_prom
methods.description: Reads calibration data from the sensor's PROM.

methods.name: ms5607_get_measurement
methods.description: Initiates a measurement and reads ADC value after delay.

methods.name: ms5607_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for pressure and temperature, then compensates.

methods.name: ms5607_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest temperature or pressure measurement as sensor_value.

methods.name: ms5607_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as oversampling rate.

methods.name: ms5607_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, reads calibration data, and configures default settings.
